homeserver.title: Homeserver
homeserver.description: Base URL of the Matrix homeserver (client-server API), without a trailing path.

room_id.title: Room id
room_id.description: Internal room id, for example !abcdef:example.org (not the #alias).

access_token.title: Access token
access_token.description: Access token of the bot user that is a member of the room. Write-only: it is masked when read back and has no default. Use ${env:VAR} to keep it out of the config file.

min_severity.title: Minimum severity
min_severity.description: Notifications below this severity are acknowledged without being sent. The host-side routing.min_severity below is applied first.

routing.title: Routing (applied by tuliprox, not by the plugin)
routing.description: Per-channel routing of the messaging outbox, the same block a built-in channel takes. Every field is optional; an empty block inherits the global notify_on.

notify_on.title: notify_on override
notify_on.description: Event id globs that replace the global notify_on for this channel (for example playlist.update.*).

min_severity.title: Minimum severity (routing)
min_severity.description: Host-side severity floor, judged on the event's registry severity before the plugin is called.

quiet_hours.title: Quiet hours
quiet_hours.description: HH:MM-HH:MM local time. Notifications inside the window are deferred, never dropped.

max_per_hour.title: Max per hour
max_per_hour.description: Circuit breaker: after this many notifications in an hour the channel sends one suppression notice and goes quiet.

dedup_window_secs.title: Dedup window (seconds)
dedup_window_secs.description: Suppress a repeated dedup key for this many seconds.
